title: Drunk Man Causes 4-Vehicle Accident Then Goes Nuts
description:
On September 29, 2021, police were notified of a male that drank too much and left a local bar driving a darker-colored vehicle in La Crosse, WI. Later, a witness called in an accident involving the same vehicle crashing into parked cars on the road. Turned out the man did drink a bit too much...
